builds.name: Reference: AP sustained duel
builds.goal: Reference for Azir: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A soldier-positioning mage who deals sustained line damage while preserving escape routes and a defensive displacement ultimate. Separate soldier damage from ordinary attacks. Confirm which on-hit effects soldiers apply at the current effectiveness and count safe soldier hits rather than awarding full on-hit value. AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration.
builds.summary: AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration.
testPlan: Kit question for Azir: Separate soldier damage from ordinary attacks. Confirm which on-hit effects soldiers apply at the current effectiveness and count safe soldier hits rather than awarding full on-hit value.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker, then Nashor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP plus real attack cadence tests sustained contact and later penetration. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Azir sends all Sand Soldiers towards a location. Sand Soldiers deal magic damage to enemies they pass through and apply a slow for 1 second. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Nashor needs actual attacks; little health/resistance makes CC and burst dangerous.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Nashor needs actual attacks; little health/resistance makes CC and burst dangerous.
Full cost 17,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Riftmaker, then Nashor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

kitEvidence.formula:
Azir summons a Sand Soldier for [10] seconds. When Azir Attacks an enemy near a Sand Soldier, he instead orders the soldiers to stab, dealing [50 / 65 / 80 / 95 / 110 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 8.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.35 / 0.425 / 0.5 / 0.575 / 0.65) × AP] magic damage in their direction.

This Ability has @MaxAmmo@ charges.
Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to an area, dealing [75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155 + (0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55) × AP] magic damage to enemies they pass through and Slowing them by [25]% for 1 second.

Azir grants himself [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.6) × AP] Shield for [1.5] seconds and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage to enemies he passes through.

If Azir hits an enemy champion, he stops and gains a Sand Soldier charge.

Azir summons a wall of armored soldiers that charges forward, Knocking Back enemies and dealing [200 / 400 / 600 + (0.75) × AP] magic damage. The soldiers remain, blocking enemy paths for [5] seconds.

Azir can summon the Sun Disc from the rubble of a turret. The Sun Disc deals [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=230, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 15.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and has [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 5.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Armor and Magic Resist but disintegrates over [45] seconds.

builds.name: Soldier resistance shred
builds.summary: Trade instant burst for a sustained soldier control zone.
builds.goal: Trade instant burst for a sustained soldier control zone.
builds.hypothesis: Arise soldiers deal magic damage with a rank-scaling 0.35-0.65 AP ratio; attack speed enables more commanded stabs. Bloodletter's stacks from qualifying magic abilities, Riftmaker rewards sustained combat and Nashor provides AP/attack speed even if soldier on-hit efficacy is unresolved. E shield and R wall buy continued command time.
testPlan: Required state: Need mana, soldiers covering the target and repeated commands before soldiers expire.
Compare stab count and MR stacks over eight seconds, with Nashor on-hit contribution logged separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Soldier displacement or forced E escape can remove the damage zone; extra on-hit expectations may fail.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Sand Soldiers are not automatically full-strength ordinary attacks for every item proc.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Bloodletter's Curse, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Sun Disc ambush anchor
builds.summary: Use a reclaimed turret as a temporary high-AP fight anchor.
builds.goal: Use a reclaimed turret as a temporary high-AP fight anchor.
builds.hypothesis: Shurima's Legacy Sun Disc lasts 45 seconds, deals magic damage with 0.4 AP and has level-scaled defenses. High AP powers its documented damage plus Emperor's Divide's 0.75 AP displacement. Rocketbelt helps angle E/R near the occupied rubble; Zhonya's buys time while opponents choose whether to retreat past soldiers or contest the Disc.

Compare turret damage and E/R catch success with and without a prepared Disc, at equal AP.

failureConditions: Enemies can disengage or destroy the Disc; investing in burst lowers steady soldier pressure.
